name: Bless
summary: Lets up to three creatures add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws.

stats.effect: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
